verdict.rationale: Sandbox0's core product is an isolated cloud computer where an AI agent can run code, install software and manage files apart from other systems. It adds outbound network policy, credential injection that keeps raw secrets out of the sandbox, and snapshot, fork and rollback so agents can test from a known state and revert. Free credit with no card lets users trial it without commitment. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the isolation guarantees, an explicit separate test/live mode or test API keys for Sandbox0's own platform, and documentation that explicitly addresses keeping production data out of sandboxes.
